name: Hollybush Playground
description: Renovated in 2022, with a climbing frame, monkey bars, a nest swing, an obstacle course, a see-saw, a slide and swings, plus baby swings and a roundabout for younger children. Most equipment suits children aged 3 and up. Next to a café, with free parking nearby.
